'''Samm''' was a [[human]] rebel who resided on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" /> A member of the [[Ghorman Front]], he accidentally killed the [[Axis network]] member [[Cinta Kaz]] during a [[Ghorman heist|mission]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>

==Biography==
[[File:SammRecruitsKarn-EBTG.png|thumb|300px|left|Samm used his job as a vendor to try and recruit Syril Karn to aid the Ghorman Front.]]
Samm was a [[Ghorman]] [[human]] who was a part of the [[Ghorman Front]], a rebel group in opposition to the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 BBY]], Samm secretly listened on a conversation between the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] member [[Syril Karn]] and his mother, [[Eedy Karn]], alongside fellow rebel [[Enza Rylanz]]. Samm believed that Syril was conflicted and sympathetic to their cause. Enza's father, [[Carro Rylanz]], arrived and decided to approve a rebel mission before Syril was transferred away. Samm, whilst working as a [[Ghorman souvenir ghorlectipod]] vendor, approached Karn, who at first rebuffed him. Samm stated he knew who Karn was and that he was not a tourist, he handed him a spider figurine with a hidden message inside. He then invited Karn to a secret meeting before retreating. Samm attended the Ghorman town hall meeting, and when [[Lezine]] began to cause an upset, he approached Karn. He thanked Karn for accepting the invitation and asked his opinion, Karn stated he admired the passion although he did not understand their language well enough. Samm explained the [[Tarkin Massacre]] to Karn and how the elderly woman that was speaking had lost her family in it. The pair are joined by Enza and then her partner [[Dilan]], and Samm teased Enza about the possibility of Karn being an imperial spy. Unbeknownst to them, Karn was an imperial spy planted to track rebel insurgency.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" /> Samm briefed the newly arrived [[Axis network]] rebel agent [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] on the Imperial convoys and how they operated.<ref name="Friends">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>

Rebel agents [[Vel Sartha]] and [[Cinta Kaz]] were sent to oversee the rebel operation when Andor refused. Sartha and Kaz met with the Front, including Samm, and instructed them to only bring what they needed. Samm stated they needed weapons and to send a message to the Imperials, but both Rylanz and Sartha refuted this. When Sartha began to finish her speech, she pointedly looked at Samm and fellow rebel [[Dreena]] as she stated those who could not follow orders should leave immediately. Dreena asked if she and Samm should leave, but both of them chose to submit to Sartha and Kaz's rules.<ref name="What a Festive Evening />

Samm operated a hover-scooter during the mission and kept watch. Male pedestrian [[Lezine]] attempted to walk past Samm, who unsuccessfully tried to persuade him to turn around. Samm then drew a blaster, despite Sartha's orders, and threatened Lezine. Lezine believed he was bluffing and the two men tussled, before Samm accidentally discharged his blaster, hitting Kaz in the chest and killing her instantly. Dreena and Sartha witnessed this, and Sartha became distraught at the death of her lover. As they escaped in the getaway vehicle, Samm began to cry, which drew the attention of the others. Sartha demanded Samm faced her, but he was initially too distraught. He repeatedly apologized before beginning to cry again, which continued to anger Sartha. Sartha stated that she did not have to tell him to remember what happened as he would have to live with the consequences and carry the life of Kaz with him for the rest of his life. She then praised Kaz as the hero Samm aspired to be, and how she would be mourned in ways Samm could not understand. Samm continued to apologize and cry, but Sartha simply rebuked him and said he did not deserve to cry for her.<ref name="What a Festive Evening />

One year later in [[2 BBY]], Samm supported Enza's call to move from being a peaceful rebellious group to one which made public demonstrations. He argued that they left dignity behind years prior, but was moved by Lezine's words of national identity and unity.<ref>[[Messenger]]</ref> Samm later prepared for the large protest in Palmo Plaza alongside [[Ghorman Front]] member [[Leeza]], who assembled a blaster for him. He and Leeza remained together during the growing crowd, and took part in the chanting and sung the national anthem. When a gunfight ensued, the pair hid behind pillars and shot at the Imperial soldiers to protect the crowd. Leeza was hit and killed by blaster fire, with Samm screaming her name in horror as he witnessed it. Samm later commandeered a troop transport and used it to ram [[K-2SO]], who was attacking Cassian Andor and [[Wilmon Paak]]. Samm recognized Andor and the two exchanged words of thanks, with Samm revealing he intended to return to headquarters. Paak, who was also Dreena's lover, wished to return as well and joined him. Before they left, Andor convinced Samm to move the droid into the transport, as well as allow Andor to escape the planet on it. Samm and Paak successfully fought their way back to headquarters where they discovered Dreena alive and making a desperate plea over the radio.  Samm watched as she and Paak embraced, before she asked them to help her spread the word of the massacre. Dreena and Paak would later evacuate Ghorman together, but Samm's survival is unknown.<ref name="Who Are You">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Samm was a passionate [[Ghorman (people)|Ghor]] freedom fighter who searched for allies sympathetic to the cause of the Ghorman Front. His cover selling handcrafted [[Ghorman souvenir ghorlectipod|souvenir spiders]] to tourists in [[Palmo Plaza]] gave him a firsthand look at the [[Galactic Empire|Empire’s]] growing presence in his home city.<ref name="SammDB">{{Databank|samm|Samm}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Samm was created for the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. The character was portrayed by [[Abraham Wapler]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />
